title: Hinomori Shiho — Because Today Is Special〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: One week before the show
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much for watching us practice again today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We really appreciate all the advice you gave us. It gave us a chance to hammer out a lot of the fine details.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Just one week to go.
I'm sure you'll do great, but you gotta stay focused, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We will.
Our goal's to put on the best show we possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right, everyone?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Honami
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, where'd Saki go...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She went with Rin to go check...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Rin's Voices
rows.Line: Aaahhhhhh!!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?! Wh-What's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's terrible!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look at the weather forecast for next week!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, it's going to rain...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What do we do?!
We're playing at an outdoor venue!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shiho...
If it rains, what does that mean for our show...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A little rain shouldn't be a problem...
From what I understand, that venue's prepared for this sort of thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But the crowd might have a tough time...
They'd have to wear raincoats and stuff since they won't be allowed to use umbrellas.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's supposed to be a Thank You Show, so I really want them to have fun and enjoy themselves...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it's not gonna rain for sure, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, the precipitation rate isn't very high...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we should still prepare for some rain. It might be good to ask the venue staff and Mr. Shindo about this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, this seems like a good time to head back and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(She's still looking at her phone...?
Is she that worried about the weather?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, let's head back...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Rin, I'll let you know what I find out the next time I'm here...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! I'll take care of things over here!
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh. Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Ah, perfect.
Saki and Rin are getting up to something very interesting in that classroom there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Something interesting?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
MEIKO, don't spoil their fun.
They've been putting so much effort into their idea.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, but they're pointing that effort in an odd direction...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I think they're at it again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why don't we take a peek at what they're doing...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Rain, rain, say goodbye! Mr. Sun, come say hi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Rain, rain, say goodbye! Mr. Sun, come say hi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're playing a song...and dancing...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wh-What are they singing...? And this dance...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Who knows...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They've been calling it the “sun dance”. Apparently, performing it brings good weather.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are they doing this for our show?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, because they don't want the audience to be troubled on account of the weather.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They came up with it together and said they're going to be performing it every day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez... And they're willing to embarrass themselves by doing this ridiculous dance?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, I understand how they feel. It's not every day that we get to perform at an outdoor venue.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Shih, you guys...!
I thought I heard people talking!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Good timing!
We were waiting for you, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because your last name has the character for “sun” in it. That's why we think you can summon it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, what are you...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Come on, Shih!
Stand here in the center of the classroom for us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're gonna be our sun!
We'll worship you by singing and dancing♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why do I have to be a part of this ridiculous ritual...?! I'm just here to work on some stuff on my own and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, why aren't you guys helping?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I say lend them a quick hand.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, praying is pretty much all that can be done when it comes to the weather.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've gotta be kidding me!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't we join in as well?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, all of you...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In that case, I can just play my bass and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, Shiho, you've gotta be the sun!
And we're gonna worship you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It'll all be over much faster if you just say yes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: F-Fine...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Just promise me you'll play well, okay?
I won't accept anything short of that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We shall! You can count on us, Miss Sunshine!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.
